verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal provides prebuilt email receipts that it documents as including all card-network-required fields. It also exposes receipt data through the API so merchants can build custom receipts, including physical ones, as long as the required information is listed. Missing for 10: SMS receipt delivery, a first-party printed-receipt capability (printing relies on the merchant building it from API receipt data), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements

citations.quote: You can use Stripe’s prebuilt email receipts, or use receipt data from the Stripe API and your Terminal integration to generate on-brand custom receipts.
Prebuilt email receipts already include all card network-required fields.
You can also customize receipts to include any design and content you want—as long as you list required information.
If you accept payments using Stripe Terminal, you must provide customers with the option to receive a physical or email receipt.
